children: The Bank of England is expected to raise interest rates further to bring U.K. inflation down towards its 2% target and this should support sterling in the near term, Commerzbank's Michael Pfister says in a note. The latest U.K. inflation data show annual headline inflation rose to 3.6% in October, from 3.5% in September, in line with expectations of economists in a WSJ poll. The inflation data show that the high energy prices are putting upward pressure on goods' prices, making it difficult for the BOE to refrain from raising rates further, Pfister says. Sterling trades flat against the dollar at $1.3151 and the euro is flat versus sterling at 0.8344 pounds. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
